title: Glassdoor Reviews Scraper & Employer Brand Monitor
description: Extract public Glassdoor reviews and employer ratings, then monitor new reviews and rating changes across scheduled runs. No login or cookies required.

companyUrls.title: Glassdoor company review URLs
companyUrls.description: Up to 20 Glassdoor Reviews URLs. Direct URLs are the fastest and most reliable input.

companyNames.title: Company names
companyNames.description: Optional company names to resolve on Glassdoor. Use direct review URLs when exact matching matters.

maxReviewsPerCompany.title: Reviews per company
maxReviewsPerCompany.description: Maximum matching reviews saved for each company. The quality-test default is deliberately small and finishes within five minutes.

filterByEmploymentStatus.title: Employment status
filterByEmploymentStatus.description: Return all reviews or only current/former employees.

filterByJobTitle.title: Job title contains
filterByJobTitle.description: Case-insensitive job-title filter, such as engineer or sales.

filterByLocation.title: Location contains
filterByLocation.description: Case-insensitive location filter, such as New York or Texas.

watchlistName.title: Watchlist name
watchlistName.description: Stable private name for recurring comparisons, for example US SaaS competitors. Reuse it in scheduled runs.

onlyNewReviews.title: Save only newly observed reviews
onlyNewReviews.description: After the first baseline, save and charge only reviews not seen in earlier runs of this watchlist.

useUnblocker.title: Use specialist anti-blocking access
useUnblocker.description: Recommended. Make one sessionless Apify Unblocker request per review page. This replaces the blocked direct, datacenter, and Residential routes and prevents repeated premium requests.

maxRunMinutes.title: Run-time limit in minutes
maxRunMinutes.description: Stops additional collection work near this limit and saves an honest partial report.

proxyConfiguration.title: Custom proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional advanced override. Leave empty for the bounded specialist Unblocker strategy.
